app.title: Voice Commander
common.name: Name
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.subtitle: Speak a command, or hold the push-to-talk key and say it.
dash.tryit.hint: Type a phrase and run it through the same pipeline as your voice.
dash.setup.title: Speech model needed
dash.setup.body: Voice Commander needs a free offline speech model before it can hear you.
listen.engine-not-ready: No speech model is loaded for the selected language.
mic.no-microphone: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
mic.microphone-missing: The selected microphone is not connected.
mic.microphone-failed: The microphone could not be opened. It may be in use by another app.
mic.title: Microphone
mic.subtitle: Choose the input device and check that your voice is picked up.
mic.mismatch.missing: No speech model installed for {0}. Voice input for this language will not work until you download one below.
mic.mismatch.freeform: {0} is using a free-form model: it cannot be restricted to your command phrases, so Arabic commands may be misheard. Install a grammar-capable model below for better accuracy. Your profile choice is unchanged.
mic.test.hint: Speak normally; the bar should move. Nothing is recorded or saved.
mic.speech.title: Speech recognition
speech.transcribe-failed: Speech recognition failed on that phrase. Please try again.
whisper.title: Whisper models (Arabic)
whisper.hint: Whisper runs fully offline on this PC. The model is downloaded once, only when you ask, and is stored outside the app folder. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
whisper.choose.hint: Pick a ggml Whisper model file (.bin).
whisper.loadfailed: The Whisper model could not be loaded.
model.busy: That model is already being downloaded.
model.disk-error: The model file could not be written to disk.
model.disk-space: Not enough free disk space for this model.
model.network: The download was interrupted. Check your connection and try again; it will resume.
model.corrupt: The downloaded file is corrupt and was discarded. Please download it again.
model.file-invalid: That file is not a valid Whisper (ggml) model.
model.size-mismatch: That file does not have the expected size, so it is incomplete or damaged.
model.title: Speech models
model.hint: Models are downloaded once, only when you ask, and then work fully offline.
model.usefolder.hint: Pick an already-extracted Vosk model folder.
model.folder-invalid: That folder is not a valid Vosk model.
model.missing.en: The English speech model is not installed.
model.missing.ar: The Arabic speech model is not installed.
cmd.title: Commands
cmd.subtitle: Everything Voice Commander understands. Built-in and custom commands work the same way.
cmd.delete.title: Delete command
cmd.restoredefaults.body: Missing built-in commands will be added back. Your edits to existing commands are kept.
cmd.packs.hint: Switch groups of commands on or off together.
cmd.duplicate: Another command already uses the phrase "{0}".
edit.name: Command name
edit.phrases.hint: One phrase per line, in English and/or Arabic. Use {number} or {app} for variables.
edit.invalid: Please fix the highlighted problems before saving.
edit.app.fromvoice.hint: Uses the application you say, e.g. “open Chrome”
edit.app.missing.error: An action uses an application that no longer exists. Select or add an application, or remove the action.
edit.app.missing.title: Application missing
edit.app.missing.body: The application used by this action is no longer registered.
apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Programs Voice Commander can open, close, focus and control by voice.
apps.empty: No applications yet. Add one or use auto-detect.
apps.name: Display name
apps.aliases.hint: Other names you might say, one per line (English or Arabic).
apps.process.hint: Used to find, focus or close the running app.
apps.path.hint: An .exe file, or a launcher link such as steam://rungameid/730.
apps.notfound: The program was not found at this path.
apps.delete.title: Remove application
apps.single: Single instance: bring the existing window forward instead of opening another
apps.force: Force close: end the process when closing by voice
apps.validation.name: Enter a name for this application.
apps.validation.dup: Another application already uses this name.
wf.title: Workflows
wf.subtitle: Custom commands that run several steps in order.
wf.empty: No workflows yet. Create one such as "Start Gaming".
hist.title: History
hist.subtitle: What was heard and what happened. Only text is stored — never audio.
model.remove.body: Remove the speech model "{0}"? You can download it again later.
set.title: Settings
set.closetotray: Keep running in the tray when closed
set.resume: Start listening when the app starts
set.wake.hint: Say it before a command, e.g. "computer, open notepad".
set.confidence.hint: Higher is stricter. Results below this are ignored.
set.similarity.hint: Off by default. Matching stays exact unless you turn this on.
set.hotkey.conflict: This combination is already used by {0}.
set.hotkey.invalid: That is not a valid shortcut.
set.hotkey.duplicate: Two actions use the same shortcut.
set.hotkey.taken: Another program already uses this shortcut.
set.dangerous: Allow power commands (shut down, restart, sign out, sleep)
set.dangerous.hint: Off by default. Even when on, each one asks for confirmation.
set.reset.body: Settings return to their defaults. Your commands and applications are kept.
set.developer.hint: Shows the Developer page with raw recognition output and a phrase simulator.
set.about.text: Offline voice control for Windows. No cloud, no accounts, no recorded audio.
set.restart.language: The language changed live; no restart is needed.
set.hotkey.hint: Click a box and press the keys. Backspace turns the shortcut off.
set.import.replace.warn: Replace will delete all your current commands and applications first. Continue?
io.export.failed: The file could not be written: {0}
io.import.title: Import commands
io.import.summary: {0} commands and {1} applications found in this file.
io.import.invalid: This is not a valid .voicecommander file.
io.import.skipped: {0} items were skipped because they were invalid.
dev.title: Developer
dev.simulate.hint: Runs the phrase through the pipeline exactly as if it had been spoken.
dev.subtitle: Test the recognizer and matcher without speaking. Visible because Developer mode is on.
dev.asvoice: Treat as spoken (apply confidence, wake phrase and cooldown)
dev.raw.empty: Nothing recognized yet. Hold the push-to-talk key and speak.
onb.title: Welcome to Voice Commander
onb.welcome.body: Control your PC by voice with phrases you define. Everything runs on your computer — no cloud, no accounts, no recorded audio.
onb.language.title: Choose your language
onb.language.body: You can change this any time in Settings.
onb.profile.title: Which languages will you speak?
onb.profile.body: This decides which speech models are needed.
onb.model.title: Get the speech model
onb.model.body: Download the free offline model once, or point to one you already have.
onb.mic.title: Check your microphone
onb.mic.body: Pick your microphone and say something. The bar should move.
onb.mode.title: How should it listen?
onb.mode.body: Push-to-talk only listens while you hold the key, which makes it the most private and accurate choice.
onb.try.title: Try it
onb.try.body: Hold {0} and say "open notepad", or use the button below.
onb.try.nocommand: Nothing happened: the command was not recognized.
onb.done.title: You are all set
onb.done.body: Explore the Commands page to see everything you can say, and add your own.
tray.minimized: Voice Commander is still running in the tray.
hotkey.problem.title: Some shortcuts could not be registered
err.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Details were written to the log.
assistant.title: Voice Commander
ptt.title: Push-to-Talk sounds
ptt.desc: A short cue when listening starts and stops.
fa.title: Floating assistant
fa.desc: A small always-available status window for the same voice pipeline.
